title: jHBV: a differentiable JAX implementation of the HBV-96 hydrological model
description:
Dual-backend (JAX + NumPy) implementation of the HBV-96 rainfall–runoff model — usable standalone or as a SYMFLUENCE plugin.

Part of the SYMFLUENCE JAX-native model family, described in the paper series accompanying SYMFLUENCE (Eythorsson et al., 2026, Water Resources Research).
